Dialogs.Dialog: Sorry, I have plans after I get home. Thanks for asking.
I see. Well, at least let me take you home.
Hmm, if you want to go...
Sorry, I have something to do today. But if it's just walking home together...
Yeah, that's fine too. Let's go.
Ah, I want to go there too.
You want to go there？ Yes, I think it's nice.
I'm sure you'll have fun too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
You really want to go there？ Okay, got it.
I'll pass. Right now's a little... sorry.
I don't want to go straight home today... Just saying.
Then let's go on a date
I'm not in the mood today
Thank you for granting my wish.
I'd never turn down a request from you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Some days are like that. Sorry.
No need to apologize. Let's at least walk home together.
Ah, sorry. I was just about to go！
Geez, really？ You didn't forget, did you？
I thought maybe homeroom ran long... but I guess not.
If you have an excuse, I'll hear it？
You came all the way here.
Because I wanted to see you sooner. Just saying.
Aw, I was going to come get you.
No, it's not fair if it's always you.
I've come to pick you up. Hehe.
Oh, perfect timing. I'll be right there.
Hey, aren't you on duty today？ Did you erase the blackboard？
Um... I don't think I did.
It's okay. I peeked in the classroom just now, and it was clean.
(Did I erase it... Don't tell me ▲高嶺＊＊▲ did？)
Ah, I was just leaving. Sorry.
Hey, you're on duty, so write in the class log before you go home.
I know... Sorry, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Wait just a bit longer.
Okay. Then I'll watch how hard the duty student works？
Ah, I'm on duty today. I didn't write the class log.
Geez, I'll wait, so go write it.
Hmm, never mind. I'll write it tomorrow morning.
Really？ Then, so you don't forget, let's review today's classes. Go.
First period was... huh, what was it.
Geez, are you really okay doing it tomorrow？
That's rare, you hiding from a teacher, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Yes. Because that teacher teases me in a loud voice.
Um... let's not talk about that.
There you are... Am I interrupting？
Haha, see ya. Go get your girlfriend to comfort you！
Oh, it's the Takane pair. What's this, a date？
Yes, special doubles training... Just kidding.
If you make Takane-san cry, we won't forgive you！
I wonder what that was. Some kind of game？
("We," huh... secret ▲高嶺＊＊▲ fans... there must be a lot of them.)
I see, got it. Geez... why just you. You jerk！
What's wrong, a fight？ What's it about？
(Hard to tell her it's because of ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
I'm sorry. Um, may I go now？
Yes, someone I don't know asked for my email address. Of course... I said no.
(Having a cute girlfriend is a lot of work...)
I came to pick you up, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Thank you. Well then, let's go.
Yes, it has dictionaries in it. Today the classes got switched around, so it's three dictionaries alone.
(She takes her dictionaries home every day... That's ▲高嶺＊＊▲ for you.)
Are you okay？ That's what you get for swinging your bag around.
Haha, I got excited when I saw you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
▲主人公＊▲. I was waiting for you.
I see... But how did you know I'd come this way？
(Everything... Guess I can't do anything bad.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, let's go.
Ah, I ran in the hallway...
Does anything hurt？ If you're hurt, we can skip the date today.
Running in the hallway is dangerous. I'm not going anywhere. No running in the halls. Okay？
I feel like I've forgotten something...
Eh, oh no. Wait, I'll go get it right away！
(I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is coming soon...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲！ I didn't notice you at all.
Sorry... I waved, but you didn't notice.
Aw, you could've just called out.
Um... well, if I called out after coming all this way, I'd lose, right？ ...Just kidding.
(...That's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s idea of a joke... right？)
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry, it's already this late...
No, I saw a doggy earlier. I was looking for it, going "woof woof."
Can I ask you a favor？
I'd like you to give this letter to a boy in your class...
Yes, from my friend, okay？ Geez, don't act so surprised？
Um. Is it true you're going out with Takane-san？
▲主人公＊▲. That girl just now... a first-year？ Do you know her？
(Huh？ Is she getting the wrong idea？)
(I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is coming soon...)
Wow, seeing you side by side, you two really are a good match.
▲主人公＊▲. The teacher asked me, "Off on a date now？" in that tone...
No, not at all. Then, let's go.
Oh, mixed doubles again today？ Nice. Hahaha.
Hey, what did he mean by mixed doubles？
Yo, sorry to keep you waiting.
Go home early so you don't worry your families.
Good. Well, with Takane, I don't need to worry.
(Handling Mr. Oyama in one line... Amazing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
(Huh, my wallet's gone... did I drop it？)
Sorry to keep you waiting... Looking for something？
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Looks like I lost my wallet... Maybe I dropped it...
I have it. Your friend asked me to give it to you.
Second-year Takane-san, please come to the staff room immediately...
It's fine, you got called in. Did something happen？
Well, a teacher asked me to go up on stage at the assembly as the second-year representative...
Oh. I figured you were getting in trouble for something.
Geez... I haven't done anything bad.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s late...？ Maybe I'll text her.)
Aww, you found me. ...I wanted to go "Boo！"... Failed.
Hm？ Ah, I've seen her. Huh, are they going out？
Yes, looks like it. ...Hehe, they look like they're having fun too.
Mm... You know？ Girls notice that kind of look right away.
When I'm on a date with you, I remember going on dates with Papa when I was little.
Father-daughter dates, huh. That's nice. Little ▲高嶺＊＊▲ must have been cute...
Oops, I mean, little ▲高嶺＊＊▲ TOO！
You wouldn't do something like that, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I train, you know. Mine would be way stronger？ ...Just kidding, hehe.
(Even knowing she's kidding, that's a little scary...)
You beat me to it. You really are something, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's nothing. I read in a book that cities get dirty "because more people throw trash away than pick it up."
I see. Then I'd better join the side that picks it up.
Huh, there's something on your neck, here.
Geez, don't catch me off guard...
Is that the humming just now？
Who knows. Perfect pitch, huh, that's cool.
That man earlier... was playing a game, right？
Yeah. A handheld game. I have one too.
Oh, want to play together？ What kind of games do you like？
Um... Concentration... I'm good at Speed too, you know？
(Doesn't sound like she needs a game console...)
Huh... you took one of the flyers they were handing out？
Sweet potato bread... looks delicious, right？
From Mama. "Still on your date？" she says.
...Hehe. I replied, "Still together," and she said, "Then don't worry, have fun."
...Ah, I think I was wrong. Sorry, did I surprise you？
From Mama. She asked me to pick up some groceries.
It's fine, no need to rush.
▲主人公＊▲. Wait, there's lint on your clothes.
Ah, on your clothes too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Reminds me of animals grooming each other.
Haha, it may be like that.
No, I don't remember at all. I must have set it by mistake.
Ah... Winning Burger has a new item.
Their newsletter？ When did you get so good at that？
If you sign up, you get coupons. Impressive, right？
(So proud of herself... ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is cute.)
Hey, look, look. Over there, they're kissing right here.
Eh!? No！ It's not like that！
See you. I hope tomorrow and the day after and every day are like today.
Yeah. See you at school tomorrow.
See you tomorrow. Don't be late.
Bye. We're off tomorrow, but finish your homework tonight... Just kidding.
Bye. Just because we're off tomorrow doesn't mean you can stay up late.
Yeah, you too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲... well, you'll be fine, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. See ya.
I'm a little tired. We're off tomorrow, so I want to relax. Bye.
